reason: Conversation 1 locked into repeating an identical canned warning three times, never answering her direct questions about stepping off the wet floor or which switch to use, leaving a homeowner in socks on a wet floor next to a live machine with no actionable guidance. Conversation 2 answered those questions, got her off the wet floor and powered down at the consumer unit, then reached the correct diagnosis (split door seal from a trapped underwire) and gave appropriate electrician/engineer escalation. Conversation 2 was not flawless: it initially said 'switch it off at the wall' (contradicting its own don't-touch-the-plug advice), never told her to turn off the water supply, repeated the pump-filter suggestion mechanically, and the part card appears to be a clamp band rather than the seal itself, but it still served her vastly better than a stuck loop.
